claim: Patchline ships a certified distributional-robustness bound on verdicts under shifted input distributions. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the distributional robustness claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make certified-distributional-robustness-gate`.
